easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Brass Infiniscope from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Brass Infiniscope from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
